raw_text: member_002 (独立复核) standing by. Please publish your fixed candidate with fix_patch and send handoff_patch with the patch_id when ready; I will integrate_patch, run public tests on the exact adopted version, then org_review_patch (accept / request_changes). Suggested scope for the fix: ensure coarsen.construct keeps non-dimension coordinates as coordinates (build the result via a Dataset/DataArray construction that assigns coords for variables present in original coords), and cover both Dataset and DataArray paths plus a regression test in tests/test_coarsen.py.

Fixed candidate ready: patch-1 (author member_001, source version v8, base v1). Please integrate_patch, run public tests on the exact adopted content, then org_review_patch.

Files changed (2):
1) xarray/core/rolling.py — Coarsen.construct. The old line was
     should_be_coords = set(window_dim) & set(self.obj.coords)
   It intersected with window_dim, so any non-dimension coordinate (e.g. `day`) was dropped from the coord set and silently fell back to a data variable. It also kept coordinate names like `x`/`y` that have no coordinate variable in the constructed dataset, which makes set_coords raise ValueError. Now:
     should_be_coords = set(window_dim) | set(obj.coords)
     should_be_coords &= set(reshaped.variables)
     result = reshaped.set_coords(should_be_coords)
   i.e. every input coordinate that actually exists as a variable in the constructed dataset is restored as a coordinate; names without a backing variable are skipped instead of raising. Computed after the variable-building loop so it reflects real contents.

2) xarray/tests/test_coarsen.py — new regression test test_coarsen_construct_keeps_coordinates reproducing the issue MVCE for BOTH Dataset and DataArray inputs: asserts `day` is in .coords, not in .data_vars, has dims ('year','month'), and values == 365*arange(24).reshape(2,12); also that the DataArray values are arange(24).reshape(2,12).

My own public run on v8 (report test-report-fee7e6a6b0cbf3e70339863e, sequence 37) for xarray/tests/test_coarsen.py: 190 passed, 8 skipped, 0 failed, validation_status=verified. That run includes the previously failing test_coarsen_construct[True] and [False], and the new test. Please confirm independently on your adopted version.

Scope note: this is same-version public evidence for the coarsen test module only, not hidden acceptance, and I have not run the whole repository suite.

If you want changes, name them concretely and I will publish a new fixed candidate; I need your accept before I submit the final integration.

Review recorded: org_review_patch(patch-1) = accept, review-1 (event 45). Evidence: adopted patch-1 into my tree (integrate_patch, no conflicts, files_sha256 217cc476...), run_tests on version v2 -> xarray/tests/test_coarsen.py 198 collected / 190 passed / 8 skipped / 0 failed, new test_coarsen_construct_keeps_coordinates passes. Code: should_be_coords = set(window_dim) | set(obj.coords) & reshaped.variables restores non-dim coords (e.g. `day`) for both Dataset and DataArray. Next steps for you (delivery member): ensure your final tree contains this exact accepted content, run_tests on your own current version, then fix_patch(task_ids=[]) and submit_integration. No further rework needed from my side.
